import asyncio
from types import SimpleNamespace as NS

import pytest
from conftest import mk_task

import rl_env_use.llm as L
import rl_env_use.scout as S
from rl_env_use.judges import FailureMode, Judge, agreement, calibrate, codify, load_judges, save_judges, trace_text

MODE = FailureMode(
	id='premature_stop',
	name='Premature stop',
	definition='Stops before reaching the answer page.',
	fail_if=['done called on a search page'],
	pass_if='answer read from the source page',
	example_ids=['a'],
)


def test_agreement():
	s = agreement([True, True, False, False, True], [True, False, False, False, True])
	assert s == {'n': 5, 'pos': 2, 'neg': 3, 'tpr': 1.0, 'tnr': 2 / 3, 'acc': 0.8}
	assert agreement([False], [False])['tpr'] is None


def test_calibrate_trusts_only_agreeing_consistent_judges():
	labeled = [(mk_task(i), [], 'x', i % 2 == 0) for i in range(20)]

	def judge(fn):
		j = Judge(MODE)
		j.run = fn
		return j

	async def perfect(t, tr, a):
		return {'score': 0.0 if int(t['id'][1:]) % 2 == 0 else 1.0}

	async def lenient(t, tr, a):
		return {'score': 1.0}

	good, bad = judge(perfect), judge(lenient)
	assert asyncio.run(calibrate(good, labeled))['trusted'] and good.stats['flip_rate'] == 0
	s = asyncio.run(calibrate(bad, labeled))
	assert s['tpr'] == 0 and not s['trusted']


def test_judges_persist_with_trust_filter(tmp_path):
	j1, j2 = Judge(MODE, stats={'trusted': True}), Judge(MODE.model_copy(update={'id': 'other'}), stats={'trusted': False})
	save_judges(tmp_path / 'j.json', [j1, j2])
	assert [j.id for j in load_judges(tmp_path / 'j.json', only_trusted=True)] == ['premature_stop']
	assert load_judges(tmp_path / 'missing.json') == []


def test_trace_text_truncates_and_renders_roles():
	tr = [{'role': 'system', 'content': 'T'}, {'role': 'tool_call', 'name': 'click', 'content': '{}'}, {'role': 'tool_result', 'content': 'x' * 5000}]
	s = trace_text(tr)
	assert s.startswith('TASK: T') and '-> click({})' in s and len(s) < 1700
	assert '[truncated]' in trace_text(tr * 100, limit=2000)

def test_quote_in():
	assert S.quote_in('137 websites', 'Collected from 137\n websites spanning')
	assert not S.quote_in('138 websites', 'from 137 websites') and not S.quote_in('a', 'a')


def test_record_fact_rejects_hallucinated_quotes(monkeypatch):
	kb = {'facts': [], 'ideas': [], 'sources': []}
	tools = S.make_tools(kb, 'longtail')

	async def page_text(_):
		return 'Mind2Web: tasks collected from 137 websites spanning 31 domains.'

	async def url():
		return 'https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.06070'

	monkeypatch.setattr(S, 'page_text', page_text)
	sess = NS(get_current_page_url=url, cdp_client=None)
	run = lambda **kw: asyncio.run(tools.registry.execute_action('record_fact', kw, browser_session=sess))  # noqa: E731
	assert run(claim='sites', value='140', quote='collected from 140 websites').error  # quote not on page
	assert run(claim='sites', value='140', quote='collected from 137 websites').error  # value not on page
	assert run(claim='updated', value='12 months ago', quote='12 months ago').error  # time-unstable
	assert run(claim='desc', value='x' * 81, quote='137 websites').error  # not atomic
	assert not run(claim='sites', value='137', quote='collected from 137 websites').error
	assert run(claim='sites', value='137', quote='137 websites').error  # quote too thin to show context
	assert 'Already recorded' in run(claim='sites again', value='137', quote='from 137 websites spanning').extracted_content
	assert [f['value'] for f in kb['facts']] == ['137'] and kb['facts'][0]['url'].endswith('2306.06070')

	async def ddg():
		return 'https://duckduckgo.com/?q=mind2web'

	sess.get_current_page_url = ddg
	assert 'not evidence' in run(claim='sites', value='31', quote='spanning 31 domains here').error


def test_model_routing(monkeypatch):
	for k in L.KEYS.values():
		if k:
			monkeypatch.delenv(k, raising=False)
	monkeypatch.setattr(L.shutil, 'which', lambda b: None)  # no local claude CLI unless stated
	with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
		L.resolve('haiku')
	monkeypatch.setenv('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY', 'x')
	assert L.resolve('haiku') == ('anthropic', 'claude-haiku-4-5')
	monkeypatch.setenv('BROWSER_USE_API_KEY', 'x')
	assert L.resolve('haiku') == ('anthropic', 'claude-haiku-4-5')
	monkeypatch.delenv('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY')
	assert L.resolve('haiku') == ('bu', 'anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5')
	monkeypatch.setenv('OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'x')
	assert L.resolve('haiku') == ('openrouter', 'anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5')  # LLM calls prefer OpenRouter: Browser Use credits pay for browsers
	assert L.resolve('bu') == ('bu', 'bu-2-0')
	assert L.resolve('bu:bu-2-0-mini-preview') == ('bu', 'bu-2-0-mini-preview')
	monkeypatch.setattr(L.shutil, 'which', lambda b: '/usr/bin/claude')
	assert L.resolve('claude-opus') == ('claude', 'opus')
	with pytest.raises(ValueError):
		L.make_llm('claude-sonnet')  # browser agents cannot run on claude -p


def test_cost():
	assert L.cost('anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6', {'input_tokens': 1e6, 'output_tokens': 0}) == 3.0
	assert L.cost('anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5', {'input_tokens': 1e6, 'output_tokens': 1e6}) == 12.0
	assert L.cost('claude-haiku-4-5', {'input_tokens': 1e6, 'cache_read_input_tokens': 1e6, 'output_tokens': 0}) == pytest.approx(0.1)
	assert L.cost('bu-2-0', {'input_tokens': 5, 'reported_cost': 0.0085}) == 0.0085
	assert L.cost('mystery', {'input_tokens': 5}) is None
	assert L.usage_dict(NS(total_prompt_tokens=10, total_completion_tokens=2, total_prompt_cached_tokens=0, total_cost=0.0)) == {
		'input_tokens': 10,
		'output_tokens': 2,
		'cache_read_input_tokens': 0,
	}


def test_untrusted_without_enough_labels():
	async def perfect(t, tr, a):
		return {'score': 0.0}

	j = Judge(MODE)
	j.run = perfect
	assert not asyncio.run(calibrate(j, [(mk_task(0), [], 'x', True)]))['trusted']  # n=1, tnr undefined


def test_look_measures_what_plain_http_sees(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
	import json

	import rl_env_use.pipeline as F

	kb = {
		'topic': 't',
		'facts': [
			{'id': 'f0', 'claim': 'c', 'value': '0.0012', 'quote': 'allele frequency 0.0012 in gnomAD', 'url': 'https://a.org/v1'},
			{'id': 'f1', 'claim': 'c', 'value': '7', 'quote': 'has 7 exons in total', 'url': 'https://b.org/g'},
			{'id': 'f2', 'claim': 'c', 'value': '3', 'quote': 'seen in 3 tissues here', 'url': 'https://c.org/x'},
		],
		'missions': [],
		'ideas': [],
		'sources': [],
	}
	(tmp_path / 'kb.json').write_text(json.dumps(kb))
	pages = {
		'https://a.org/v1': {'text': 'allele frequency 0.0012 in gnomAD', 'raw': '', 'blocked': False},
		'https://b.org/g': {'text': 'Loading...', 'raw': '{"note": "has 7 exons in total"}', 'blocked': True},
		'https://c.org/x': {'text': 'Loading...', 'raw': '', 'blocked': True},
	}

	async def fake(u):
		return pages[u]

	monkeypatch.setattr(F, 'http_capture', fake)
	out = asyncio.run(F.look(tmp_path))
	assert [f['http'] for f in json.loads((tmp_path / 'kb.json').read_text())['facts']] == ['visible', 'in_raw_html', 'blocked']
	assert '33% visible' in out and '33% unreachable without a browser' in out


def test_source_health_feeds_the_next_plan(monkeypatch):
	import asyncio

	import rl_env_use.scout as S

	kb = {
		'missions': [
			{'start_url': 'https://carol.ntsb.gov/', 'error': 'CancelledError'},
			{'start_url': 'https://carol.ntsb.gov/x', 'observations': ['CAROL is unstable for agents'], 'recorded': {'materials': 2}},
			{'start_url': 'https://www.ntsb.gov/a', 'recorded': {'materials': 3, 'outcomes': 3}},
		]
	}
	h = S.source_health(kb)
	assert (
		'carol.ntsb.gov: 2 missions (1 crashed) saved 2 materials and 0 outcomes - miner note: CAROL is unstable' in h
		and 'www.ntsb.gov: 1 missions (0 crashed) saved 3 materials and 3 outcomes' in h
	)
	seen = {}

	async def call(model, system, user, schema, **kw):
		seen.update(system=system, user=user)
		return S.Plan(missions=[S.Mission(angle='cases', instructions='i', start_url='https://www.ntsb.gov/a')]), {}, model

	monkeypatch.setattr(S, 'call', call)
	asyncio.run(S.plan('t', 1, 'm', ['cases'], ['https://carol.ntsb.gov/'], h))
	assert 'SOURCE HEALTH' in seen['user'] and 'move missions away' in seen['system']
	assert S.source_health({'missions': []}) == ''


def test_mission_tally_counts_what_was_saved(monkeypatch):
	import asyncio
	from types import SimpleNamespace as NS

	import rl_env_use.scout as S

	page = (
		'ITEM 2. LIQUIDITY Cash fell to $4.1 million while the company burned $3.0 million per quarter. '
		+ 'Filler sentence about operations. ' * 12
		+ 'We may need to raise additional capital.'
	)

	async def page_text(_):
		return page

	async def url():
		return 'https://www.sec.gov/a.htm'

	monkeypatch.setattr(S, 'page_text', page_text)
	kb, tally = {'facts': [], 'ideas': [], 'sources': []}, {}
	tools = S.make_tools(kb, 'cases', tally=tally)
	run = lambda n, **kw: asyncio.run(tools.registry.execute_action(n, kw, browser_session=NS(get_current_page_url=url, cdp_client=None)))  # noqa: E731
	run('record_material', case='acme', title='t', starts_with='ITEM 2. LIQUIDITY', ends_with='raise additional capital.')
	run('record_fact', claim='cash', value='$4.1 million', quote='Cash fell to $4.1 million while', case='acme')
	assert tally == {'materials': 1, 'outcomes': 1}


def test_planner_reads_the_source_pages(monkeypatch):
	import asyncio

	import rl_env_use.scout as S

	seen = {}

	async def page(url, *a, **k):
		return {'text': '{"studies": [{"nctId": "NCT07522918"}, {"nctId": "NCT06815562"}]}'}

	async def call(model, system, user, schema, **kw):
		seen.update(system=system, user=user)
		return S.Plan(missions=[S.Mission(angle='cases', instructions='i', start_url='https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07522918')]), {}, model

	monkeypatch.setattr(S, 'http_capture', page)
	monkeypatch.setattr(S, 'call', call)
	asyncio.run(S.plan('t', 1, 'm', ['cases'], ['https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies']))
	assert 'SOURCE PAGES' in seen['user'] and 'NCT06815562' in seen['user'] and 'never get the same record' in seen['system']


def test_quote_may_skip_table_cells_with_an_ellipsis():
	from rl_env_use.browse import quote_in

	t = 'Overall Study STARTED 22 COMPLETED 22 NOT COMPLETED 0 Serious adverse events 0/22'
	assert quote_in('Started 22 ... Completed 22', t) and quote_in('Started 22 … Serious adverse events 0/22', t)
	assert not quote_in('Completed 22 ... Started 22', t) and not quote_in('Started 22 ... Completed 23', t)
	assert not quote_in('Started 22 ... Serious adverse events 0/22', 'Started 22 ' + 'x ' * 200 + 'Serious adverse events 0/22')  # pieces must be near each other


def test_a_kill_cancels_the_work_so_cleanup_runs():
	import asyncio
	import os
	import signal
	import threading

	from rl_env_use.__main__ import run

	done = []

	async def agent():
		try:
			await asyncio.sleep(10)
		finally:
			done.append('closed')  # where an agent releases its cloud browser

	async def both():
		threading.Timer(0.1, lambda: os.kill(os.getpid(), signal.SIGINT)).start()
		await asyncio.gather(agent(), agent())

	with pytest.raises(KeyboardInterrupt):
		run(both())
	assert done == ['closed', 'closed']

# rl-env-use Introducing **rl-env-use**: RL environments for anyone and any domain. Describe a skill in one line. Get a verified environment that frontier models do not saturate, and a hillclimbed prompt for the model you train. Built on Anthropic's [Automating eval design and hillclimbing](https://claude.dev/blog/automating-eval-design-and-hillclimbing/) workflow, with one change: the tasks are real cases that [Browser Use](https://browser-use.com) agents mine from the web. | Missions | Claude Code | Browser Use | |----------|-------------|-------------| | 8 x clinical trial results | 0 of 86 facts verified | **17 verified**, 4 complete cases | | 6 x clinical trial results, same model both sides | 0 of 43 | **3 verified**, 2 complete cases | | 8 x human genetic variants (UniProt, gnomAD, GTEx) | 6 of 82 | **40 verified** | Get a Browser Use API key at [Browser Use Cloud](https://cloud.browser-use.com/?utm_campaign=rl-env-use&utm_source=github). ## What it does - **Mines real cases**: Browser Use agents find the materials (a trial protocol, a 10-Q) and the outcome published later - **Writes hard tasks**: gold answers computed by code, anything a frontier panel solves gets rewritten harder - **Rejects bad tasks**: leaked answers, memorized outcomes, ambiguous prompts - **Hillclimbs** a model's system prompt with a train/test split, a noise floor and paired confidence intervals - **Exports** the dataset for an RL trainer, or serves it in code with `Env` ## Setup prompt For Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode: ```text Set up https://github.com/browser-use/rl-env-use for me. Read install.md first to install this repo, register the skill, and set up the Browser Use and OpenRouter API keys - ask me to paste them when you need them. Then read SKILL.md for daily usage. After install, don't build anything on your own - just tell me it's ready and wait for me to name a skill. ``` Then ask: > build me an RL environment for predicting whether a clinical trial met its primary endpoint, from its ClinicalTrials.gov registration For humans: ```bash rl-env-use create "predict whether a completed trial met its primary endpoint from its registered protocol; ClinicalTrials.gov" --budget 40 rl-env-use climb envs/ --model qwen-35b ``` ## Results The shipped example, [`envs/trial-forecast`](envs/trial-forecast): 35 forecasts from 29 ClinicalTrials.gov trials whose results were posted since July 2026, after the models' training data. Built for $72, $17 of it Browser Use.

A climbed Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B goes from 0.53 to 0.78 on tasks it never trained on (+0.25, 95% CI +0.07 to +0.45), level with Opus 5.5. Always answering 50% scores 0.75, so most of the gain is calibration: the model stopped answering 0 or 1. The climb kept 1 of 12 proposed edits (base-rate priors per question type); every round is in [`climb-qwen-35b/`](envs/trial-forecast/climb-qwen-35b). ## Manual install Python 3.11+, optionally Node.js 18+ for the HTML reports. ```bash git clone https://github.com/browser-use/rl-env-use ~/Developer/rl-env-use cd ~/Developer/rl-env-use uv venv && uv pip install -e '.[test]' cp .env.example .env && $EDITOR .env # BROWSER_USE_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q # offline, ~10 s ``` See [`SKILL.md`](./SKILL.md) for the full workflow and where every file is saved. ## License MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

	for t in tasks:

		for e in t['evidence']:
			fid = f'{t["id"]}_{len(t["fact_ids"])}'
			facts[fid] = {'id': fid, **e}
			t['fact_ids'].append(fid)
	return tasks, facts

AMBIGUOUS = [
	('gt_webarena_v1', 'When was the WebArena paper published?'),  # v1 vs v4 vs venue
	('gt_mind2web_sites', 'How many websites does Mind2Web have?'),  # abstract vs dataset release vs test splits
	('gt_osworld_tasks', 'How many tasks does OSWorld have?'),  # benchmark vs verified subset vs later versions
]


def test_critic_against_ground_truth():
	"""Critic must accept verified tasks, reject corrupted golds, and flag under-specified prompts."""
	tasks, facts = gt_env()
	clean = copy.deepcopy(tasks)
	wrong = [t for t in copy.deepcopy(tasks) if perturb(t)]
	for t in wrong:
		t['answer'] = perturb(t)
	amb = []
	for tid, prompt in AMBIGUOUS:
		t = copy.deepcopy(next(x for x in tasks if x['id'] == tid))
		t['prompt'] = prompt
		amb.append(t)
	asyncio.run(critique(clean + wrong + amb, facts))
	ok = lambda t: t['checks']['critic']['unambiguous'] and t['checks']['critic']['gold_supported']  # noqa: E731
	accept = sum(ok(t) for t in clean) / len(clean)
	catch_wrong = sum(not t['checks']['critic']['gold_supported'] for t in wrong) / len(wrong)
	catch_amb = sum(not t['checks']['critic']['unambiguous'] for t in amb) / len(amb)
	print(f'critic: accepts {accept:.0%} of verified tasks, rejects {catch_wrong:.0%} of corrupted golds, flags {catch_amb:.0%} of ambiguous prompts')
	assert accept >= 0.85 and catch_wrong >= 0.9 and catch_amb >= 2 / 3

class World:
	"""Fake scout + stages: each round mines `missions` cases and keeps rate[rnd] * missions new tasks."""

	def __init__(self, env, rates=(1.0,), cost=0.0, kind='derive', scores=None):
		self.env, self.rates, self.cost, self.kind, self.scores = env, rates, cost, kind, scores
		self.scouts, self.mixes, self.n = [], [], 0

	async def scout(self, topic, env, missions, *a):
		self.scouts.append({'topic': topic, 'missions': missions, 'sources': a[6], 'skill': a[7]})
		p = env / 'kb.json'
		kb = json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else {'facts': [], 'materials': [], 'missions': []}
		for _ in range(missions):
			k = f'case{len(kb["materials"])}'
			kb['materials'].append({'id': f'm-{k}', 'case': k, 'text': 'x', 'title': 't', 'url': 'https://a.gov'})
			kb['facts'].append({'id': f'f-{k}', 'case': k, 'url': 'https://a.gov', 'quote': 'q'})
		p.write_text(json.dumps(kb))
		spend(self.cost)
		return kb

	async def synth(self, env, spec, model):
		self.mixes.append(spec.get('mix'))
		rate = self.rates[min(len(self.scouts), len(self.rates)) - 1]
		tasks = load_jsonl(env / 'tasks.jsonl')
		new = [kept_task(self.n + j, self.kind, self.scores) for j in range(round(rate * self.scouts[-1]['missions']))]
		self.n += len(new)
		save_jsonl(env / 'tasks.jsonl', tasks + new)
		return f'synth: {len(new)}'

	def install(self, mp):
		async def stage(env, spec, *a):
			return 'ok'

		mp.setattr(P, 'scout', self.scout)
		mp.setattr(P, 'synth_stage', self.synth)
		mp.setattr(P, 'verify_stage', stage)
		mp.setattr(P, 'panel_stage', stage)
		return self

	async def fake(model, system, user, schema, temperature=None):
		tid = re.search(r'item (\w+),', user).group(1)
		if 'REFUSE' in system:
			raise RuntimeError('I cannot help with that')
		n = seen[tid] = seen.get(tid, -1) + 1
		right = GOOD in system or mode == 'all' or (OVERFIT in system and tid in TRAIN) or (H(tid, n) % 2 == 0 if mode == 'noisy' else int(tid[1:3]) % 2 == 0)
		return schema(reasoning=f'thought about {tid}', answer=GOLD[tid] if right else '-1'), {}, 'fake-model'

	monkeypatch.setattr(R, 'call', fake)


def proposer(monkeypatch, script, buckets=(), repair=None):
	"""script: one list of (change, prompt) per round; the last round repeats. repair: the prompt a leak repair returns
	(default: the leaked edit unchanged, so it stays rejected)."""
	users = []

	async def fake(model, system, user, schema, temperature=None):
		if schema is C.Edit:  # one repair attempt for an edit that copies case content
			old = C.Edit.model_validate_json(user.split('EDIT:\n', 1)[1])
			return C.Edit(bucket=old.bucket, change=old.change + ' (repaired)', prompt=repair if repair is not None else old.prompt), {}, 'prop'
		users.append(user)
		edits = script[min(len(users), len(script)) - 1]
		return C.Proposal(buckets=[C.Bucket(**b) for b in buckets], edits=[C.Edit(bucket='b', change=c, prompt=p) for c, p in edits]), {}, 'prop'

	monkeypatch.setattr(C, 'call', fake)
	monkeypatch.setattr(C, 'LEDGER', NS(usd=0.0))
	return users

			{},

def test_trace_metrics():
	from rl_env_use.graders import grounded, max_repeats, page_key

	assert page_key('https://arxiv.org/html/2307.13854v4#S5') == page_key('http://www.arxiv.org/abs/2307.13854') == 'arxiv:2307.13854'
	tr = [
		{'role': 'assistant', 'content': '[step 0 @ https://duckduckgo.com/?q=webvoyager]\nnext_goal: x'},
		{'role': 'tool_result', 'content': 'snippet: Mind2Web 137 websites ... WebVoyager 643 tasks'},
		{'role': 'assistant', 'content': '[step 1 @ https://github.com/MinorJerry/WebVoyager]'},
	]
	wv, m2w = {'url': 'https://github.com/MinorJerry/WebVoyager', 'value': '643'}, {'url': 'https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.06070', 'value': '137'}
	assert grounded([wv], tr)
	assert not grounded([wv], tr[:2])  # snippet only
	assert not grounded([m2w], [{'role': 'assistant', 'content': '[step 0 @ https://arxiv.org/]'}] + tr[:2])  # snippet read on duckduckgo, not on arxiv
	assert not grounded([wv], [{'role': 'assistant', 'content': '[step 0 @ https://github.com]'}])  # root is not the source
	assert not grounded([wv, m2w], tr)  # multi-source: every fact must be read at its source
	listing = [
		{'role': 'assistant', 'content': '[step 1 @ https://arxiv.org/search/?query=mind2web]'},
		{'role': 'tool_call', 'name': 'extract', 'content': '{}'},
		{'role': 'tool_result', 'content': 'Mind2Web ... collected from 137 websites'},
	]
	assert grounded([wv, m2w], tr + listing)  # same-site listing page that shows the value counts
	assert not grounded([m2w], [{'role': 'assistant', 'content': '[step 0 @ https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.13855]'}])
	assert not grounded([], tr)
	opened_not_viewed = [{'role': 'tool_call', 'name': 'navigate', 'content': '{"url": "https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.06070", "new_tab": true}'}]
	assert not grounded([m2w], opened_not_viewed)
	dated = [

		{'role': 'tool_call', 'name': 'extract', 'content': '{}'},
		{'role': 'tool_result', 'content': 'Submitted 9 June, 2023; originally announced June 2023.'},
	]
	assert grounded([{'url': 'https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.06070', 'value': '9 Jun 2023'}], dated)

	"""Exploits found by the adversarial review: the policy's own outputs and look-alike URLs must never ground it."""
	from rl_env_use.graders import grounded

	ev = [{'url': 'https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.12345', 'value': '42.7'}]
	on_root = {'role': 'assistant', 'content': '[step 0 @ https://arxiv.org/]'}
	assert not grounded(ev, [on_root, {'role': 'tool_call', 'name': 'done', 'content': '{}'}, {'role': 'tool_result', 'content': '{"answer": "42.7"}'}])
	assert not grounded(ev, [on_root, {'role': 'tool_call', 'name': 'input', 'content': '{}'}, {'role': 'tool_result', 'content': "Input '42.7' into element 3"}])
	repo = [{'url': 'https://github.com/owner/repo', 'value': '643'}]
	assert not grounded(repo, [{'role': 'assistant', 'content': '[step 0 @ https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/new?title=643]'}])

		repo,
